title: Flatten a Multilevel Doubly Linked List
inputFormat: head is a node with val, prev, next, and child pointers, or null. Test inputs use numbers or {val, child:[...]} entries; [] becomes null.
outputFormat: Return the head of the flattened list using the original nodes and values. All child pointers must be null and prev links must be correct. The runner displays the returned list as a value array.
